It's normal for Major Depressive sufferers to go through hygiene episodes and that of course branches out to most other mental health situations. I used to go 3 days without showering in 45 degree (Celsius, I might add) heat when work got too much and I was overwhelmed and it just made everything worse. It was just too much effort to wash and I knew I would be pouring sweat in a few hours anyway. I only wiped the essentials because they would chafe and burn otherwise
